name: Agent view
summary: One screen to start, watch and answer all your background Claude Code sessions.
what: Agent view lists your background sessions by state: working, waiting for you, or done. You can send new tasks, peek at a session, reply, or attach to see the whole conversation. It is a research preview.

impact.title: Run many tasks
impact.detail: Keep several sessions going in parallel.

impact.title: Step in only when needed
impact.detail: See at a glance which session needs input.

impact.title: Survives closing the terminal
impact.detail: Background sessions keep running on your machine.

howItWorks: Run claude agents to open agent view.
Move a session to the background with the left arrow or /background.
Press Space to peek and Enter to attach.
Sessions run on your computer and use your plan's quota.

events.note: Added agent view (research preview), opened with claude agents.
